# Psalm 35 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. Contend, YHWH, with-those-who-contend with-me; fight against-those-who-fight against-me.

**2** Take-hold-of shield and-buckler, and-rise-up for-my-help.

**3** And-draw-out spear and-javelin to-meet my-pursuers; say to-my-soul, 'I [am] your-salvation.'

**4** Let-them-be-put-to-shame and-dishonored, those-seeking my-soul; let-them-be-turned-back and-humiliated, those-devising my-harm.

**5** Let-them-be like-chaff before the-wind, and-the-angel of-YHWH driving [them].

**6** Let their-way be darkness and-slippery, and-the-angel of-YHWH pursuing-them.

**7** For without-cause they-hid for-me their-net; without-cause they-dug for-my-soul.

**8** Let-destruction come-upon-him unawares, and-his-net which he-hid catch-him; into-destruction let-him-fall.

**9** And-my-soul shall-rejoice in-YHWH; it-shall-exult in-His-salvation.

**10** All my-bones shall-say, 'YHWH, who [is] like-You, delivering the-afflicted from [one] too-strong for-him, and-the-afflicted and-needy from-the-one-robbing-him?'

**11** Malicious witnesses rise-up; what I-do-not-know they-ask-me.

**12** They-repay-me evil for good, bereavement for-my-soul.

**13** But-I, when-they-were-sick, my-clothing [was] sackcloth; I-afflicted with-fasting my-soul, and-my-prayer returned upon my-bosom.

**14** As-a-friend, as-a-brother to-me I-went-about; as-one-mourning a-mother, [in] gloom I-bowed-down.

**15** But-at my-stumbling they-rejoiced and-gathered — they-gathered against-me; stricken-ones I-did-not know tore [at me] and-did-not cease.

**16** With godless mockers at-a-feast, they-gnash at-me [with] their-teeth.

**17** Lord, how-long will-You-look-on? Rescue my-soul from-their-ravages, my-only-one from-the-lions.

**18** I-will-give-You-thanks in-the-great assembly; among a-mighty people I-will-praise-You.

**19** Let-not rejoice over-me my-treacherous enemies; those-hating-me without-cause — let-them-not wink the-eye.

**20** For not peace they-speak, but-against the-quiet of-the-land they-devise words-of deceit.

**21** And-they-open-wide against-me their-mouth; they-say, 'Aha, aha! Our-eye has-seen!'

**22** You-have-seen, YHWH; do-not be-silent. Lord, do-not be-far from-me.

**23** Rouse-Yourself and-awake for-my-justice, my-God and-my-Lord, for-my-cause.

**24** Judge-me according-to-Your-righteousness, YHWH my-God, and-let-them-not rejoice over-me.

**25** Let-them-not say in-their-heart, 'Aha, our-desire!' Let-them-not say, 'We-have-swallowed-him.'

**26** Let-them-be-put-to-shame and-humiliated together, those-rejoicing at-my-harm; let-them-be-clothed [with] shame and-dishonor, those-magnifying [themselves] against-me.

**27** Let-them-shout-for-joy and-be-glad, those-delighting in-my-righteousness; and-let-them-say continually, 'Great [is] YHWH, who-delights in-the-peace of-His-servant.'

**28** And-my-tongue shall-declare Your-righteousness, all the-day Your-praise.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **35:10**: 'All my bones' — the whole body praises. This is not metaphor but testimony — salvation is felt in the body.

— EMET
